name: Sea cliff
desc: The edge of things - confrontation, ultimatum, the last place before the drop.
tags: scenery, no humans, sea cliff, grass clifftop edge, sheer rock face, ocean far below, waves breaking on rocks, sea spray, seabirds, horizon line, wind bent grass
prose: a grassy clifftop breaking away into a sheer rock face, the ocean far below with waves breaking white on the rocks, spray in the air, seabirds turning at eye level and a hard horizon out to sea
note: The drop is what gets omitted - you get a beach viewpoint with the sea at ground level and no height at all. Three nouns put the camera on top of the cliff: the sheer rock face, the water FAR BELOW, and birds at EYE LEVEL. Wind-bent grass does more for exposure than any adjective about wind ever will.
